business: Studio ljepote Mila — beauty and PMU studio (epilacija, lice/tijelo, lash & brow, permanent makeup, edukacije, professional shop) in City Kvart, Podgorica, run by Dragana Mila. The page's only conversion route is an Instagram DM; an existing external shop is linked, not rebuilt.
artDirection: A warm "printed magazine" direction: porcelain and dusty-rose grounds instead of grey, a very large Cormorant Garamond masthead carrying the studio name, small tracked micro-caps as the only furniture, and the artist's real handwritten signature PNG as the one signature element — scroll-wiped in from the left like a pen writing, echoed once by a hand-drawn stroke under the masthead. Rose is deployed as ground (hero bleed panel, the whole Edukacije band), not as a 9px accent; carbon is spent exactly once, on the closing contact band. One motion idiom, scroll-driven, no JS.
strengths: The signature is a genuinely subject-grounded signature element: her real handwritten PNG, alpha-on-porcelain with no plate behind it, wiped in left-to-right by scroll (mila.module.css .signature + @keyframes mila-write). It is specific to THIS artist and could not be lifted onto another demo. Keep it exactly.

Rose deployed as a ground rather than an accent — --mila-rose-field #e6c9ce as a real full-bleed panel behind the hero portrait (verified: it does reach x=1440 at 1440px) and again as an entire section ground for Edukacije. Combined with warm porcelain #f6f0ec instead of cool grey, this is the strongest anti-slop decision on the page.

The desktop masthead (page.tsx 148-174): studio name at clamp(2.4rem,10vw,8.4rem) with 'Mila' in rose italic, set as a

so it correctly does not compete with the hero

. This is the best single moment in the rendered page.

Editorial honesty discipline: researchOnly in data.ts parks address, phone, prices, years-of-experience and certification claims as null with notes, and the rendered page invents none of them. No fake stats, no fake testimonials, no medical or outcome promises anywhere in the copy. Keep this rule.
Restraint in image count: one portrait, printed once. Refusing to reprint the same photo as a fake 'gallery' is the right instinct even though it creates a density problem (see issues).

Interaction detail on the entrance rules: the rose underline is already partly drawn at rest (scaleX 0.55/0.4/0.28) and completes on hover/focus, so the colour is present without an interaction and the hover is an extension rather than a reveal. Reduced-motion is handled, focus-visible outlines exist on every interactive element, and hit targets are min-h-11/min-h-12 throughout.

One filled surface on the entire page (.primaryCta, square corners, thin carbon border, rose fill on hover) with every other action a word plus a rule. The restraint of the button system is correct — the problem is only what it is pointed at.

issues.issue: The second full screen of the page is ~85% empty. Measured on the 1440px shot: the section is ~700px tall and holds three small text clusters — 'Tretmani' top-left, 'Permanent makeup' floating alone at middle-right, 'Edukacije' bottom-left — with a continuous void of roughly 400x340px in the centre-right and another across the bottom-right. Nothing anchors them: no rule, no image, no grid line, no baseline they share. This is not asymmetric composition, it is scatter. At 768px it is worse: all three collapse to the left rail with max-w-sm decks, leaving the entire right half of the section blank for its full height.

The entrances section is also redundant with what follows. Its three doors are Tretmani, Permanent makeup, Edukacije — all three reappear as items in 'Šta se radi' two sections later, and all three are already in the header nav. It costs a full screen of scroll to restate the nav. Worse, its decks are the source of visible verbatim duplication: 'Rad milimetrom: linija se crta prema licu, strpljivo i tiho.' is printed here AND appended to the PMU cell in Šta se radi (page.tsx 374), and 'pigment se polaže u tankim potezima, tako da crta prati oblik lica umjesto da ga nadglasa' appears near-verbatim in both the Potpis paragraph (299-301) and the PMU treatment line (data.ts 96). Two sentences each printed twice inside one scroll.

Conversion is unclear and under-weighted for a service business. The one filled/bordered CTA ('Pogledaj tretmane') is spent on an in-page anchor scroll; the actual conversion (message the studio) is a text link repeated four times at identical weight (header, hero, Edukacije, closing band) so none of them reads as primary. The closing dark band — the page's one loud moment — sets the LOCATION ('City Kvart, Podgorica') at clamp(2rem,5.2vw,3.6rem) and the actual action at clamp(1.4rem,3.2vw,2.1rem), so the biggest type on the last screen is not something anyone can act on. There is no booking affordance, no hours, no price band, no Viber/WhatsApp — near-universal for a Montenegrin beauty studio — and no map. A prospect looking at this cannot see how it wins them bookings.
issues.where: hero CTA row page.tsx 205-220; closing #kontakt band 456-500

issues.issue: For a beauty studio there is no evidence of the work anywhere. One portrait of the artist (a studio headshot with a flower, reading as stock glamour rather than craft) and then roughly 3,000px of unbroken text: entrances, Potpis, Šta se radi, Edukacije, Shop, Kontakt — six consecutive bands with zero imagery. Brows, lashes, PMU healed line work and the treatment room are what this business physically sells, and the page shows none of it. With only one licensable photo available, the layout should have been built around that scarcity; instead it just leaves the rest of the page empty of pictures and asks type to carry a visual craft.
issues.where: whole page below the hero; portrait is the only Photo in data.ts (121-130)

issues.issue: Section grammar is identical five times: micro-caps kicker → serif h2 → muted deck. Gdje početi, Šta se radi, Edukacije, Shop and Dolazak all open the same way, so nothing signals which section matters. Three of the five kickers are literal substrings of their own heading — 'ŠTA SE RADI' over 'Šta se radi u studiju.', 'EDUKACIJE' over 'Edukacije pod istim potpisom.', 'SHOP' over 'Profesionalni shop već postoji.' — so the kicker is furniture that carries no information. This is exactly the mono-caps-kicker-plus-serif-everywhere broadsheet grammar the house standard bans as an applied-identically template.
issues.where: kicker const page.tsx 40, used at 248, 337, 389, 426 and mirrored at 462

issues.issue: The hero rose mat has accidental-looking geometry. Measured on the desktop shot: rose panel spans x 674→1440, y 304→999; the photo sits at x 736→1263, y 392→996. That is a mat of 62px left, 88px top, 176px right, and ~3px bottom — the photograph is effectively flush with the bottom edge while a 176px band of flat empty rose sits to its right. It reads as a rectangle that ran out rather than a deliberate asymmetric mat, and the flush bottom kills the 'framed print' idea the code comment describes.

Dead zone on the hero's left rail. The masthead stroke ends around y=280 and the kicker does not start until y≈514 — roughly 230px of empty porcelain on the first screen — because lg:items-center vertically centres a ~340px text block against a ~700px photo column. Another ~155px of emptiness follows below the CTA row before the section ends. The first screen therefore has a strong masthead, a strong picture, and a hole between them.
issues.where: hero grid, page.tsx 183 (lg:items-center) and left column 192-221

issues.issue: The Edukacije band is the emptiest and least informative section on the page. Measured: the rose band runs ~365px tall and its top ~180px is entirely blank rose — lg:items-end drops the heading low while the right column's shorter stack starts high, so the band reads as a pink rectangle with text sitting oddly at the bottom. Content-wise it delivers nothing a prospective student needs: no program, no duration, no group size, no what-you-leave-with, no level. Two sentences, one of which is the fourth restatement of 'dogovaramo porukom'. A visitor who clicks the Edukacije door arrives at less than the door promised.

Title sizes in 'Šta se radi' vary by array index parity (index % 2 === 0 ? 1.4-1.9rem : 1.2-1.6rem), which is a column-position artefact, not meaning. On the 2-col desktop grid it makes each row's left title visibly larger than its right title on a different baseline — 'Epilacija / laser' vs 'Tretmani lica i tijela', 'Edukacije' vs 'Profesionalni shop' — and the ~15% delta is too small to read as hierarchy, so it reads as a rendering fault. On the 390px single column the same rule produces an apparently random big/small/big/BIG/big/small sequence. It also asserts that epilacija matters more than face and body treatments, which nothing supports.

A ~370px empty cell sits in the middle of 'Šta se radi': 'Lash & brow lift' occupies the left column of row two while the right cell of that row is blank, before the full-width PMU cell. Combined with max-w-sm decks that stop ~320px short of each column's width, the right half of this section is mostly air. The section reads sparse rather than considered.

No density rhythm. Five of six main sections use the identical py-16 sm:py-24; only the Shop bridge differs (py-10 sm:py-12). Every band is therefore the same weight and the same height signature, so the page scrolls as one uniform cadence with no compression or release. The house standard's 'varied section density' is not present.

On a 390px phone the masthead loses its cover status. clamp(2.4rem,10vw,8.4rem) resolves to ~2.44rem while the h1 clamp(2.1rem,6.6vw,4rem) resolves to ~2.1rem — a 16% gap. The two largest serif lines on the first screen are effectively the same size, separated only by a squiggle and a 10px kicker, so the mobile opening reads as two competing headlines instead of masthead-then-headline. The desktop hierarchy (8.4rem vs 4rem) does not survive the shrink.
issues.where: masthead page.tsx 150 vs hero h1 197; visible in studio-ljepote-mila-phone.png

issues.issue: Door labels do not match their destinations. The 'Permanent makeup' entrance and the 'Potpis' nav item both point at #potpis, whose heading is 'Jedan potpis nad tretmanima, edukacijama i shopom.' — a section about the artist's through-line, not about PMU. The page's actual PMU content is the enlarged cell inside #tretmani, which nothing links to. Meanwhile id='kontakt' exists on the closing band and is never linked from anywhere.
issues.where: data.ts entrances 60-65; nav page.tsx 120-123; section ids 283, 333, 457

issues.issue: The 'potpis' metaphor is doing the work that information should do. It appears in the hero subtitle ('pod jednim potpisom'), the Edukacije entrance deck ('pod istim potpisom'), the Potpis h2, the Edukacije h2 ('pod istim potpisom') and the signature figcaption — five times, in a page that otherwise tells the visitor no price, no duration, no hours, no procedure and no what-to-expect. The rhetoric reads as filling in for missing substance rather than as a considered motif.

The Cormorant Garamond + warm off-white + tracked 10px micro-caps + oversized serif masthead combination is the single most common 'AI luxury' fingerprint. Strip the rose grounds and the signature PNG and the remaining skeleton — kicker/serif-h2/muted-deck five times over, a dash-marked category list, sparse floating text clusters — is the editorial-broadsheet template. The two genuinely specific elements (signature, rose-as-ground) are carrying the entire differentiation.
issues.where: font setup page.tsx 14-25; kicker const 40; overall section grammar

issues.issue: Six identical rose dashes (h-[3px] w-8, w-14 for PMU) head the six treatment entries. It is a repeated ornament whose only job is 'an item starts here' — the same structural role the banned decorative 01/02/03 numbering plays, with a dash substituted for the numeral. It does not encode anything about the treatment.

Header nav type is 0.6rem (~9.6px) uppercase with 0.14em tracking on phones. In the 390px shot the four links are close to unreadable. Below 420px 'Potpis' is additionally hidden, so the nav silently drops to three items with no indication anything is missing.
issues.where: nav links page.tsx 124-132 and the visibility rule at 121

issues.issue: The rose rule under the right-aligned 'Permanent makeup' entrance grows from the left (.entrance::after uses transform-origin: left center for all three). Under a right-aligned title the partial rule therefore hangs from the word's left edge and stops mid-phrase, pointing away from the text's alignment. It should mirror for the right-aligned door.

The drawn stroke under the masthead is max-w-xs/sm and left-anchored, so on desktop it is a ~300px squiggle sitting under 'Studio' beneath a ~1000px-wide masthead. It relates to neither the masthead's measure nor to the rose word 'Mila' it is presumably gesturing at, and stops at an arbitrary point.

runningFoot is exported from data.ts with a comment describing 'the magazine running foot under the masthead' and is never imported or rendered anywhere. Dead export plus a comment that documents an element the page does not have — the next person will trust the comment.

No skip-to-content link, although main carries id='vrh' and the header holds five interactive elements before the first heading. Cheap to add and the rest of the accessibility work here is careful enough that its absence stands out.

The portrait crop reads as glamour stock rather than as this studio. object-[50%_14%] on phone and md:object-[50%_5%] centre a symmetrical headshot with large flat grey backdrop on both sides; at 768px the top of the flower ornament sits tight to the frame edge. Nothing in the frame says beauty studio, PMU, or Podgorica — it would sit unchanged on a singer's or a model's page.

verdict: The art direction itself is real and worth defending: warm porcelain instead of grey, rose used as an architectural ground rather than a 9px accent, and one motion on the page which is the artist's actual handwriting being written. Those three decisions are subject-grounded and could not be copy-pasted onto another business. Everything built on top of them, however, is the generic editorial template — micro-caps kicker over serif h2 over muted deck, five times running, with three kickers that merely repeat their own headline — plus four consecutive text-only bands for a business whose entire product is visible craft. The composition is not art-directed so much as under-filled: the entrances screen is ~85% empty at 1440 and dead on the right half at 768, the hero mat has 176px of orphan rose on one side and 3px on another, the Edukacije band opens with 180px of blank pink and then says nothing a student could act on, and title sizes in the treatments index vary by array index rather than by meaning. Conversion is the sharpest miss: the one filled button is spent on an anchor scroll, the real action is a text link repeated four times at equal weight, and the largest type on the closing screen is a neighbourhood name instead of anything a visitor can do. Against the studio's best work this reads as a strong cover and a strong signature bolted onto a page that has not decided what its middle is for.
